summary: The ACE rack-based barbell squat version places the bar across the upper back.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described hip extension; exercise involvement is not measured or ranked.

setup: Set the bar in a rack below shoulder height. Position it across the upper back and grip wider than shoulder width.
Lift the chest and draw shoulder blades together. Unrack, step back and place feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
executionSteps: Sit the hips back while keeping the chest raised and back straight; the guide describes lowering the hips below the knees.
Press the feet into the floor and move the hips forward to return to standing.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position.
keyCheckpoints: Keep the source-described chest and back position.

mistakes.mistake: Departing from the source-described back position.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this guide; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Keep the source-described chest and back position.

summary: A floor-start barbell deadlift with the source-described mixed grip and controlled hip movement.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described hip extension; exercise involvement is not measured or ranked.

setup: Stand behind the bar with feet about shoulder width, toes slightly outward and shins close to the bar.
Move the hips back, keep the back straight and chest raised, then take the guide's over-under grip.
executionSteps: Grip firmly, press the feet into the floor and bring the hips forward while keeping the back flat. Finish standing tall with straight legs.
Return by moving weight toward the hips and bending the knees while keeping the back straight.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position.
keyCheckpoints: Maintain the source-described back position while moving the hips.

mistakes.mistake: Departing from the source-described back position.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this guide; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Maintain the source-described back position while moving the hips.

summary: The ACE dumbbell version of a squat holds one weight vertically in front of the chest.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described hip extension; exercise involvement is not measured or ranked.

setup: Stand about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell vertically in front of the chest.
executionSteps: Keep elbows near the ribs and the back straight while lowering; the guide describes hips below knees.
Press both feet into the floor to return to standing.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position.
keyCheckpoints: Keep elbows close to the ribs and the back straight.
